source_map.note: amd.com product page, row 'Name'. URL patterns: https://www.amd.com/en/products/graphics/desktops/radeon/<N>000-series/amd-radeon-rx-<model>.html for RX 6000/7000/9000 (slugs vary: 7900xtx, 7900xt but 7900-gre, 7800-xt, 6800-xt, 9060xt); RX 400/500/5000/Vega/VII have no product page under that path (404) and are read from the support spec page https://www.amd.com/en/support/downloads/drivers.html/graphics/radeon-600-500-400/radeon-rx-500-series/radeon-rx-580.html (and .../radeon-rx/radeon-rx-5000-series/amd-radeon-rx-5700-xt.html, .../radeon-rx/radeon-rx-vega-series/radeon-rx-vega-64.html). Both are read by page.py with a plain request. web.archive.org answered 429, not needed.
No segment field; the page's 'Typical Board Power (Desktop)' row and the URL path 'desktops' give it. Some Polaris/Vega pages list 'Board Type Component' or 'Desktop , Component'.

ROCm gpu-specs table: Name | Architecture | LLVM target | VRAM | CUs for RX 6000/7000/9000 (not 7600 XT, 9060 XT 8GB by name) and Radeon VII. Polaris pages say '4th Gen GCN Architecture'; RX 5700/5700 XT pages say 'RDNA Architecture'. 7600 XT: ir.amd.com release (s8) says 'RDNA 3 compute units'. Vega 56/64 and RX 5500/5600 XT pages give no architecture.

Row 'Launch Date' on RX 6000, 7900 series, 500 series, 590, 5500 XT, 5700 and 5700 XT pages. Missing on RX 7800/7700/7600/7600 XT, 9000 series, RX 400 series, 5600 XT: press release date on ir.amd.com ('Released <date>').
Row 'Max Memory Size'. On older support pages it is the maximum for the model name; variants with less memory (RX 560 2GB, RX 570 4GB, RX 5500 XT 4GB) are not separate pages.
Row 'Memory Type'.
Row 'Memory Interface' on all pages except RX 7900 XTX/XT and RX 5500 XT (absent); for the 7900 pair the RDNA 3 release s3 gives the bus; RX 5500 XT left empty.
Row 'Memory Speed Up to N Gbps'.
Row 'Memory Bandwidth Up to N GB/s' (the plain figure is the cell); 'Effective Memory Bandwidth' (with Infinity Cache) on RDNA 2/3 cards is kept in a note.
Row 'Stream Processors'; 'Compute Units' on the same page goes in the note.
Boost frequency 'Up to N MHz' (page also gives Game Frequency, Base Frequency on old cards).
'Peak Single Precision (FP32 Vector) Performance' (RDNA, Vega, VII) or 'Max Performance Up to N TFLOPs' (Polaris, RX 590).
RDNA 3/4 pages: 'AI Accelerators N' (the instructions are WMMA, gpuopen s20/s19). RDNA 2, RDNA 1, Vega, Polaris pages list none.

gpuopen s19 table (RX 7900 XTX vs RX 9070 XT): FP16, BF16, FP8, BF8, IU8, IU4; s20 sentence for RDNA 3 WMMA (FP16, BF16, 8-bit and 4-bit integer); RDNA 4 product pages list FP16/FP8/INT8/INT4 Matrix lines.
'Peak Half Precision (FP16 Vector) Performance' row on RDNA, Vega, VII pages; Polaris pages give none.

ROCm compatibility matrix (current, ROCm 10.1.0); operating systems per card only on the older s16 page (7.14.0), whose sentence 'If a GPU is not listed on this table, it’s not officially supported by AMD' supports false
Adrenalin release notes 'Vulkan 1.4 Support' (25.5.1) with its Radeon Product Compatibility list; s31 Vulkan driver support page scopes it to that list
Polaris, Vega, Radeon VII support pages list 'OpenCL® 2.0'; nothing on AMD pages for RX 5000 to RX 9000
